en-US.author: Serhii Zhyhunenko
en-US.description: Fast Media Sorter & Sharing for Windows - a media and file manager that sorts photos and videos with one key per file, manages files on disks and servers and shares folders to your phone over SFTP (off until you switch it on).
en-US.installationNotes: This package is unsigned - Windows may show a SmartScreen warning on first run. What to expect and click: https://serzhyale.github.io/FastMediaSorter_Lite/trust.html
en-US.longDescription:
Four optional parts: a media and file manager that views and sorts photos and videos with one
key and manages files in local folders, on servers and on connected devices; a
local sharing service that shares folders over SFTP and connects this PC to an exchange account;
scheduled file operations that run copy, move, delete and archive on a timetable, installed
together with the Share Manager; and a Media Exchange Server that you run yourself, through which
your devices reach each other - start with the manager or with the folder-sharing server, and add
the rest only if you want it. This package installs the manager, with local sharing and the
scheduled operations as optional components that stay off until you switch them on; the
Media Exchange Server is not in this package.

Fast Media Sorter & Sharing for Windows is a fast, keyboard-driven way to view and sort photos and
videos, with a file manager mode for local folders, SFTP and SMB servers and
connected devices. Tick folders to browse, then move, copy, rename or delete files with single-key
hotkeys - built for photographers and creators who triage large media folders quickly. It handles a
wide range of formats, slideshow and random modes, EXIF auto-rotate, an Ambilight-style background
fill, and optional on-image OCR translation.

Sharing here means giving your own media to your own devices: the bundled Share Manager turns the PC
into a private SFTP server for the folders you pick, and the Android app pairs with it by QR code. It
also joins this PC to an exchange account. It is opt-in and stays off until you switch it on.

Scheduled file operations copy, move, delete and archive files on a timetable, with a preview and a
journal of every run, in their own window opened from the tray, the viewer's folder menu or a key
you assign. They need no folder sharing, no server, no open port and no administrator rights, and
run while the Share Manager runs in your signed-in session: they are installed together with the
Share Manager - one payload, no separate download and no Windows service. The setup wizard lets you
leave both out: the Compact type installs the manager without folder sharing and scheduled
operations.

The main program is now a 64-bit .NET 10 build that carries its own runtime - there is nothing extra
to install and no .NET Framework requirement. It replaces the previous version in place and keeps
your settings. Video always plays through the built-in VLC engine (H.264/MP4, AVI, MKV, VP9, ZMBV and
more), and static and animated WEBP images open on their own, without the Windows "WebP Image
Extensions" codec that some editions of Windows lack.

A 32-bit build with the same feature set ships alongside it for Windows 7/8.1 and 32-bit machines.
The installer picks the right one for your PC automatically and points the shortcut and file
associations at it, so there is nothing to choose. The 64-bit main program requires Windows 10
version 1607 or newer, Windows 11, or Windows Server 2016 or newer.

The interface is available in 13 languages - English, Russian, Ukrainian, German, Italian,
Spanish, French, Portuguese, Arabic, Hindi, Bengali, Urdu and Chinese - and picks the one your
Windows display language uses on first run; a button on the toolbar switches it at any time.
The bundled Share Manager speaks the same 13 languages and follows the same choice. Only
English, Russian and Ukrainian are proofread by the author; the rest are machine translations,
and corrections are welcome through the issue tracker. The setup wizard itself stays English.
en-US.name: FastMediaSorter LITE
